events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-424 worktree and private stack state
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git status --short | head -20 && git log --oneline -5 && git log --oneline origin/main -3 && ls /tmp/t424* 2>/dev/null | head; for p in 8940 8941 8942 8943 8944; do lsof -ti:$p >/dev/null && echo "$p up" || echo "$p down"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: List private stack files and port state
events.input: $ ls /tmp/t424/; for p in 8940 8941 8942 8943 8944; do /usr/sbin/lsof -ti:$p >/dev/null && echo "$p up" || echo "$p down"; done; tail -5 /tmp/t424/dc4.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read stack scripts and latest domain-chain log
events.input: $ cat /tmp/t424/stack.sh | head -60; echo ---; cat /tmp/t424/sim-reset.sh; echo ---; tail -15 /tmp/t424/dc5.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect latest logs and run-chain script
events.input: $ ls -lt /tmp/t424/*.log | head -5; grep -c PASS /tmp/t424/dc5.log; grep -E 'FAIL' /tmp/t424/dc5.log | head; sed -n 1,19p /private/tmp/t424-wt/app/scripts/run-chain.sh; sed -n 44,200p /private/tmp/t424-wt/app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun probe-domain-chain on private stack
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt/app && bash /tmp/t424/sim-reset.sh; sleep 3; SIM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8942 FUNNEL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8944 CENTRE_PERSIST=/tmp/t424/state timeout 600 node scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs "$(cat /tmp/t424/admin-url)" /tmp/t424/d0 > /tmp/t424/dc6.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -c PASS /tmp/t424/dc6.log; grep -E 'FAIL|Error|at /' /tmp/t424/dc6.log | head

events.text: Reran domain-chain; it exited 127 (a command not found), so I'm checking which one.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun probe-domain-chain without timeout wrapper
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt/app && SIM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8942 FUNNEL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8944 CENTRE_PERSIST=/tmp/t424/state node scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs "$(cat /tmp/t424/admin-url)" /tmp/t424/d0 > /tmp/t424/dc6.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -c PASS /tmp/t424/dc6.log; grep -E 'FAIL|Error|at /' /tmp/t424/dc6.log | head
